FIELD.NAME: tabletype
FIELD.COMMENT: admin table-type override (0=Required,1=Optional,2=Logs); null = use the derived default

FIELD.NAME: discovered
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = row auto-registered by the dynamic-table discovery service (plugin-family prefix rule), not hand-added by an admin

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_colpart
TABLE.COMMENT: Blackboard Collaborate per-user session attendance, pulled from the Collaborate cloud API by the collab_sync task

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_colsync
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks which Collaborate sessions have already been synced (finished sessions pulled once)

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_blkhash
TABLE.COMMENT: Verification sweep: per-entity fingerprints of id blocks, as last confirmed delivered (committed), written by a pass not yet confirmed (pending), or seen to differ by an unconfirmed pass (suspect)

FIELD.NAME: fingerprint
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of format + site id + delivery destination; a row is valid only for this value

FIELD.NAME: entity
FIELD.COMMENT: exporter registry key

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: committed, pending, suspect, or folding (a suspect set being rebuilt)

FIELD.NAME: part
FIELD.COMMENT: first block number the row holds (rows of one set never overlap)

FIELD.NAME: passstart
FIELD.COMMENT: start of the pass that wrote this row

FIELD.NAME: blocks
FIELD.COMMENT: base64 of packed [block number, truncated sha256] entries

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_sweep
TABLE.COMMENT: Verification sweep: each entity's position in its current pass and the record of its last completed one

FIELD.NAME: entity
FIELD.COMMENT: exporter registry key

FIELD.NAME: passgen
FIELD.COMMENT: completed passes; its parity picks the census page slot

FIELD.NAME: passstart
FIELD.COMMENT: start of the pass in progress; 0 when none is

FIELD.NAME: scanstarted
FIELD.COMMENT: the same instant on the plugin clock, as stamped into the census

FIELD.NAME: passbatch
FIELD.COMMENT: snapshot_batch of the pass in progress

FIELD.NAME: nextblock
FIELD.COMMENT: next block number to read

FIELD.NAME: pageno
FIELD.COMMENT: census pages written by this pass

FIELD.NAME: idcount
FIELD.COMMENT: ids in those pages

FIELD.NAME: pagesok
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 once a page failed to write: the pass then emits no manifest

FIELD.NAME: clkstate
FIELD.COMMENT: clockless tally of the pass so far: seen,count,maxid,gapped

FIELD.NAME: emittedend
FIELD.COMMENT: last time this pass wrote to the buffer

FIELD.NAME: lastpassstart
FIELD.COMMENT: start of the last completed pass; the next may start 24 h later

FIELD.NAME: lastcomplete
FIELD.COMMENT: when the last pass completed

FIELD.NAME: pendstart
FIELD.COMMENT: window of the completed pass whose fingerprints await confirmation

FIELD.NAME: failures
FIELD.COMMENT: consecutive runs that failed at the same position

FIELD.NAME: parkeduntil
FIELD.COMMENT: a failing entity is not retried before this time

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_ulogin
TABLE.COMMENT: Login count per user, counted from the standard log by the count_userlogins task

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: user id

FIELD.NAME: logins
FIELD.COMMENT: logins counted since the first count

FIELD.NAME: mark
FIELD.COMMENT: generation of the flush that last changed the row

TABLE.NAME: local_intellistream_ulstate
TABLE.COMMENT: State of the count_userlogins task: one row, each field written on its own

FIELD.NAME: lastid
FIELD.COMMENT: highest log id counted

FIELD.NAME: upper
FIELD.COMMENT: counting stops at this log id; never lowered

FIELD.NAME: nextupper
FIELD.COMMENT: highest log id seen, waiting to become upper

FIELD.NAME: nextupperat
FIELD.COMMENT: when nextupper was seen

FIELD.NAME: restartat
FIELD.COMMENT: when the log ids were first seen below lastid

FIELD.NAME: passtarget
FIELD.COMMENT: end of a count from zero; 0 when none is running

FIELD.NAME: width
FIELD.COMMENT: log ids per block, from the last run

FIELD.NAME: generation
FIELD.COMMENT: raised by every flush, reset and erasure

FIELD.NAME: purgeto
FIELD.COMMENT: totals with a lower mark are still to be deleted after a reset

FIELD.NAME: resetreq
FIELD.COMMENT: requests to count from zero

FIELD.NAME: resetdone
FIELD.COMMENT: resetreq last acted on

FIELD.NAME: reshipreq
FIELD.COMMENT: requests to send every total

FIELD.NAME: reshipdone
FIELD.COMMENT: reshipreq last acted on

FIELD.NAME: shipfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: the round of sending takes marks above this; -1 when no round is running

FIELD.NAME: shiptarget
FIELD.COMMENT: and at or below this

FIELD.NAME: shipcursor
FIELD.COMMENT: last user id the round sent

FIELD.NAME: shipfull
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the round sends every total

FIELD.NAME: shipmark
FIELD.COMMENT: totals with a mark at or below this were sent

FIELD.NAME: lastfullship
FIELD.COMMENT: when every total was last sent

FIELD.NAME: lastflushat
FIELD.COMMENT: when counts were last written

FIELD.NAME: sitekey
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the site id the totals were last sent for

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: last problem of the task, as a lang key and its parameters (JSON); null after a normal run

FIELD.NAME: lasterrorat
FIELD.COMMENT: when lasterror was recorded

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: when the row was last written
